plain_text:
In the occupied Palestinian territory, health workers in hospitals are
battling to provide the right kind of people-centred care to COVID-19
patients. Many are older people, cannot have visitors due to the virus,
and urgently need both medical attention and social support. In an area
already facing conflict and crisis, the Ministry of Health is transforming the
hospital sector to better respond to present and future challenges.
